title: RunPod endpoint accepts configuration but rejects processing as paused
body: CONFIRMED: REST and GraphQL reported workersMax=1 for existing endpoint, but POST /run returned 409 ENDPOINT_PAUSED after 60 seconds. No job accepted. Capacity restored 0/0, original template restored, owned templates and Hostear uploads deleted. Health still reported throttled=1, all execution states and jobs zero. Root cause unknown. Eight phase4 local tests pass; real GPU restoration and quality verdict remain pending.
